meta.title: Todos and quick notes
meta.description: Adds a "Todos and quick notes" page to the left sidebar for logging what you did each day. Entries are added, edited and deleted in place, nest as parent and child, and carry an automatic colour label plus tags. Lists are split into unfinished and completed tabs, grouped by day, with unfinished entries first; entries older than today are marked as carried over and can be moved to today with one click. Each entry can hold links, a multi-line progress note shown as a timeline, and a 0-100% progress value; below 100% the bar uses the page accent, at 100% it turns green and the entry counts as done. A calendar tab opens a month grid where one click on a day files a new entry under that date, and an overview tab shows the day's totals, a seven-day chart, the tag distribution, six page themes, and an editable daily summary you can copy or hand to the session agent; entries with progress are listed separately there, for writing a report. A button in the conversation composer files the current conversation as an entry. Everything is stored on this machine in a SQLite database, in a directory you choose and can move; changed rows are written incrementally, and an existing JSON data directory is imported once, keeping the original files as .imported-bak. Nothing is uploaded, no API key is needed, and there is no third-party dependency: the database uses Node's built-in node:sqlite, and if that is unavailable the plugin falls back to JSON snapshot and journal files. Uninstalling the plugin removes the page, the composer button and the styles; it does not delete your data.
